accepts.because: somebody said something. Every turn with text becomes ONE call to the decider over every known topic (R-29-6): there are no trigger words, and the state of the call is the turn's text and nothing else

the graph moved, and an app with `shows` may have arrived or changed. Each one asks every such app for its topics once; a code cell has no boot event, so the receipt of this hive's own installation is the first ask

an app said its topics (`{topics: [...]}`, the manifest of the template README). Each topic is checked against the catalogue copy and replaces that app's rows; a malformed, duplicate or overflowing topic is refused out loud on `in_show {op: refused}`, never kept quietly

the owning app answered a data request: `{topic, turn_id, sets: {<name>: {value?, rows?, audience_set}}}`. Several partial answers may come; each can release blocks, and only data whose `audience_set` covers the screen's round counts
the screen reports a gesture on a presenter window. The windows carry no control, so it is heard and answered with nothing
the screen refused a write. It is heard and answered with nothing: the journal row of the turn already says what was shown

a tool call of the generation the presenter is installed for, overheard on the builder's tap (`observes_tool_calls`, restamped `in_tool_call`): one of the generation's own tools (web_search, web_fetch, bash, file, edit). It is data and nothing else (R-29-6): it becomes one row of the `work` table and opens no window and asks the decider nothing. The lane docks at `./stage`, past this rim, because the mutation door matches the producer's lane at the observing cell

a tool result of that generation, overheard (`observes_tool_results`, the string form: every result of its own `./tools` and of the member's memory, unstamped). A result whose call was observed fills in that call's state; a web search's result gives the turn that caused it its hits, in the round the result carries. Anything else is not ours and is dropped; nothing is answered

a resident's answer to a declared source of one of the presenter's own topics, restamped by the builder's `reads_residents` edge with `hop.resident`, `hop.resident_status` (the resident's own route), the `op_id` the read carried and `hop.resident_round` (the member's round the read was asked with). The source's paths pick its rows or value; the set's round is `resident_round` and never anything in the body, and an answer without it shows nothing

a model package for the decider, pushed by the colony's llm-registry: a PARAMS-ONLY body that the llm cell merges into its live params and answers with nothing. It goes from this path straight to `./decide`, the one llm cell of this hive, past `stage`, because a params body is not a request. Draw it only from the registry's `update` lane, restamped `in_model`; as shipped nothing is drawn and the decider runs on its start values. The door deletes the inner context of the hive on the way in (`show_origin`, `show_phase`, `show_id`), so a push can never pose as a turn's verdict; a refusal that does not name this decider (a push for another cell, or one without `subscriber`) reaches `stage` and leaves as `error` `decide_refused`, never as a `no_route` inside this hive

emits.because: a sure verdict opened a window, or a block was placed in it. One view per topic, `show-<topic>`, on the canvas; which surface holds it is the wiring's question
the window waited `data_wait_ms` and no block could be placed: an open window with nothing in it is no window

`{op: topics}` to every app with `shows`, `{op: data, topic, request, lead, also, turn_id, sets}` to the one app that owns the chosen topic (`hop.show_app`), `{op: refused, topic, reason}` to an app whose topic was refused

a store bundle or a clock order failed, or `./decide` refused a message that was no turn's call (`decide_refused`). It leaves rather than being logged, because a presenter that kept a fault to itself would be a screen that quietly stopped answering

a model package pushed through `in_model` that `./decide` refused: its error, with the decider's path in `hop.refused_subscriber` and the named model in `hop.refused_model`, leaves here instead of reaching `stage` as a verdict. A parent without an edge for it dead-letters it `no_route`, loudly

a sure verdict on one of the presenter's own topics whose candidates declare a source: one read per wanted set, `hop.resident` naming the resident, `hop.op_id` the turn and set, plus the source's own hop keys and body, where a value that is exactly `$request` becomes the turn's text. The builder's `reads_residents` edge carries it to the resident in the member's round; without that road it dead-letters, loudly

edges.condition: has(hop.route) && (hop.route == 'turn' || hop.route == 'mutation_committed' || hop.route == 'show_topics' || hop.route == 'show_data' || hop.route == 'event' || hop.route == 'receipt' || hop.route == 'resident_answer')

description.purpose: The presenter: when the decider is sure that something on the screen helps with what was just said, something is shown. Every turn asks the decider once; a sure verdict opens a window with a working hint and asks the owning app for its data; blocks slide in as their data arrives.
description.use_when: On a member with a screen and at least one app that declares `shows`.
description.not_in_scope: No trigger words, no data or memory sent to the decider, no layout or focus (the screen's curator decides), no port and no credential of its own beyond the decider's key.
